text: sf object: source layer (e.g. municipal boundaries). sf object: target layer (e.g. PHU boundaries). method Character. Assignment rule crosswalk: "within" (default) / "intersects": spatial-join predicate. method = "within" polygonal point-type, join direction geometrically degenerate (polygon never "within" point). case build_crosswalk() auto-corrects joining within instead, emits informative message, builds output schema corrected join. "point_on_surface": representative-point assignment point-like polygons. polygon reduced single guaranteed-interior point (sf::st_point_on_surface(), centroid, can fall outside concave polygon) joined "within" boundaries. must polygon layer. "largest_overlap": -scale polygon--polygon assignment. polygon assigned single polygon shares largest intersection area , coverage column reports winner's share polygon's area. layers must polygonal. "weighted": polygon--polygon apportionment. Every intersecting polygon retained, coverage reporting share polygon's area. Coverage values polygon sum 1, equal 1 layer fully covers . largest_overlap result argmax row weighted result. build_crosswalk() returns assignment table : never emits contains geometry. "largest_overlap" uses intersection internally area arithmetic .
